thread.title: Just a quick update on our community stats before

author: barchart.com
title: Just a quick update on our community stats before
text:
Just a quick update on our community stats before we get to last season\u2019s winners!
The Estimize community has done it again, propelling us to a record quarter for number of estimates, contributors and stocks covered during the Winter 2018 season. For the first quarter we received 197,064 estimates, the most ever in Estimize\u2019s history! Those estimates came from 8,904 contributors, a 1.5% increase from the year-ago quarter, on a total of 2,023 stocks. The Spring season is already off to a strong start, so keep your estimates coming!
Now onto our Winter 2018 winners!
One of our regulars, Sean Udall ( UdallTechStrat ), takes the top spot for highest points per estimate with an average of 23.16, followed by Bill Maurer ( Bill_Maurer) with 21.45 points per estimate.
Other exciting results came from contributors Strong_as_an_Ox , Analyst_8030355 , and upandtotheright . All three contributors achieved points\/estimate scores of over 21.
In regards to total points, we have repeat winners as well! With Sandhu taking the lead with an incredible 28,363. Mark Connolly ( NCIA ) came in a close second, followed by Frederick Tremblay (QuantTrader007) , T.J. Kyner ( tjkyner ) and Zilvinas Spetuliunas ( Spekoliunas ).
Dalton takes the win for the economic indicator competition as well. Nice job! \u00a0Other winners include Giuseppe Kali ( Kalos ), walter2166 , Spekoliunas, and Analyst_9023061 .
Finally, here are your Winter 2018 winners by sector. Congratulations to all!

Leagues winners for the Winter Season
The 10th quarter of Leagues officially closed on March 30th! Thank you to all who participated! We\u2019re pleased to announce the winners of the Q4 season, and the amazing prizes they\u2019ve been awarded.
But before we get to that, we\u2019d like to let you know that Leagues for the Q1 2018 season is open for play! As we head into peak earnings season next week, be sure you join one of our sponsored leagues covering topics such as: Popular in Tech , Travel , Food & Beverages , Media , and Going Green , among others!
Increase your chances of winning by joining more leagues and estimating on all stocks included in each! Get started now!
Third-party Sponsored Leagues
Acquisdata Pty Ltd : Companies that operate in the media and telecom space similar to Acquisdata. This league contained 19 stocks and had 239 members.
Tjkyner collected 358 points and won 6 Corporate or 12 College Annual Subscriptions to Acquisdata Industry SnapShots valued at $4,500.
Estimize Sponsored Leagues
Wide World of Sports : \u00a0Companies that produce the apparel, equipment facilities and content for sports lovers world wide. This league contained 32 stocks and had 242 members.
Lichtf accumulated 439 points, winning a $300 gift card to Nike.
Travel : The businesses that help you see the world. This league contained 43 stocks and had 231 members.
Spekoliunas takes this one! He wins with 731 points covering 91% of the stocks and will receive $300 in Airbnb credit for his efforts!
Under-Covered Stocks : The companies that don\u2019t get as much love from analysts. This league contained 41 stocks and had 303 members.
NCIA wins this one, scoring 639 points for 40 estimates. He will receive a $300 Amazon gift card.
Food & Beverages : Companies that feed us with mouth-watering foods and beverages. This league contained 43 stocks and had 177 members.
Analyst_656238 also took the top spot on this one, grabbing a $300 Starbucks gift card.
Vices : From Alcohol to Gaming, these stocks have an interest in our hard-to-break habits. This league contained 32 stocks and had 219 members.
A win for Raven here, who walks away with a GoPro Hero5 Session!
Going Green : Carbon footprint conscious companies. This league contained 32 stocks and had 211 members.
Another big win for Raven who takes the top slot with 562 total points. He wins $300 in AAPL stock.
Popular in Tech : From newcomers to giants, these are some of the most popular companies in tech. This league contained 52 stocks and had 489 members.
Congrats to dalton for winning this one with 1,143 points. He will receive an Apple\/iTunes gift card!
Energy : These stocks are powering the energy industry. \u00a0This league contained 38 stocks and had 162 members. \u00a0
PCLA wins this league with 607 points on 38 estimates.
Media in the 21st Century:
A collection of businesses competing in a rapidly changing landscape. \u00a0This league contained 25 stocks and had 63 members. \u00a0
Gjy140030 takes this one with 458 points for his 25 scored estimates.
Estimize Economics, Consumer : This covered popular economic indicators pertaining to you the consumer. The league contained 24 indicators and had 142 members. \u00a0
Spekoliunas takes this one and will win a $300 Wal-Mart gift card.
Estimize Economics, Employment: This covered economic indicators covering the ever so popular employment data. The league contained 25 indicators and had 102 members
Guido_Coenen scored an impressive 469 points and will take home 1 year subscription to the publication of his choice.
Estimize Economics, International:
This league covered international economic indicators from around the globe and contained 59 indicators and had 53 members.
Spekoliunas scored an impressive 1,395 points!
Want to see your name on this list at the end of the season?? Join today!
The Spring season is open for play and everyone has a clean slate. It\u2019s time to get estimating, so join a League and be sure to make at least 25 estimates to increase your chances of being recognized as a top Estimizer!
